description: Public in-game Drop Backpack and building catalog. Builder assets are shared by the Tools menu, item picker, and inventory.

assets.name: Grand Build Floor
assets.description: A flexible blank world for original builds.

assets.name: Open Studio
assets.description: An open-plan interior with a softly raised production floor.

assets.name: Connected Suite
assets.description: Linked indoor rooms ready for galleries, homes and quests.

assets.name: Garden Courtyard
assets.description: A sheltered green exterior with a central gathering mound.

assets.name: Small Vendor Street
assets.description: A close-knit shop lane with stalls, awnings and social corners.

assets.name: Creator Studios
assets.description: Indoor and exterior production bays for music, art and fashion.

assets.name: Market Square
assets.description: A lively open market ring with a central event plaza.

assets.name: Mountain Terrain
assets.description: High ridges, a winding pass and overlooks for adventure builds.

assets.name: Crystal Cavern
assets.description: A dark underground chamber lit by luminous crystal formations.

assets.name: Railroad Track World
assets.description: Twin rails cross an industrial landscape with a station platform.

assets.name: Skyport Airport
assets.description: Runway, terminal apron and hangar pads for airborne worlds.

assets.name: Deep Mine
assets.description: Terraced quarry terrain with a descending haul road and work zone.

assets.name: Sunrise Farm
assets.description: Rolling crop fields, farm lanes and a welcoming homestead yard.

assets.name: Coastal Cliffs
assets.description: A large windswept coast with layered cliffs, a sheltered beach and ocean overlook.

assets.name: Ancient Forest
assets.description: A vast old-growth woodland with a winding trail, moss clearings and quest ruins.

assets.name: Neon Wetlands
assets.description: A broad luminous marsh with raised islands, glowing pools and enemy encounter lanes.

assets.name: Desert Airfield
assets.description: A broad sand airport with a runway, apron, hangar and clear combat sightlines.

assets.name: Dune Sea
assets.description: Rolling sand ridges and sheltered bowls for races, quests and survival play.

assets.name: Blacksite Compound
assets.description: Competitive three-lane FPS compound with cover, towers and a central objective.

assets.name: Cargo Yard
assets.description: Commercial shipping yard built for fast flanks, container lanes and team combat.

assets.name: Neon Arena
assets.description: Broadcast-ready cyber arena with mirrored spawns and glowing objective platforms.

assets.name: Desert Outpost
assets.description: Tactical desert base with guarded lanes, bunkers and long-range sightlines.

assets.name: Mega Mall
assets.description: Multi-store commercial concourse with kiosks, storefronts and a bright atrium.

assets.name: Office Tower
assets.description: Corporate floor plate with meeting suites, cubicles and a central lift core.

assets.name: Firing Range
assets.description: Purpose-built training range with firing bays, targets and safe observation deck.

assets.name: Movie Studio
assets.description: Production backlot with sound stages, prop streets and flexible shooting bays.

assets.name: Houndette
assets.description: A loyal neon hound who patrols the world and always returns to check on you.

assets.name: MuzKat
assets.description: A curious music cat who explores every corner between player visits.

assets.name: Mousey
assets.description: A tiny, brave scout with a taste for cheese and quick adventures.

assets.name: Bee Duck Carrot
assets.description: A crunchy speed snack. Feed it to Bee Duck, then refill it for 5 MZK.

assets.name: Houndette Power Bone
assets.description: A power bone made just for Houndette. Feed it for a rainbow speed burst, then refill it for 6 MZK.

assets.name: MuzKat Beat Fish
assets.description: A shimmering beat fish made just for MuzKat. Feed it for a rainbow speed burst, then refill it for 7 MZK.

assets.name: Mousey Moon Cheese
assets.description: A moon-cheese wedge made just for Mousey. Feed it for a rainbow speed burst, then refill it for 4 MZK.

assets.name: RAD-TOX Dynamite
assets.description: Throw a live stick in RAD-TOX. Its animated blast deals 100 radius damage for 25 MZK per use.

assets.name: Volt Wolf Armor
assets.description: Shoot the armor block three times to release it, add it to your active Backpack loadout, and pin it to the torso socket.
